item.title: Here’s Where to Watch 2026 WNBA Games Online
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we're excited to dive into the world of sports. The WNBA is back for its 30th season, and we've got all the details on how to catch the action. From superstar A'ja Wilson and the Las Vegas Aces to other top players like Caitlin Clark and Breanna Stewart, this season is shaping up to be an exciting one."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The season runs from May to October 20th, with a two-week break in August and September for the FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup tournament. But don't worry, you won't miss a game - you can check out the complete WNBA 2026 regular season schedule online."
[Short music transition]
Host: "So, where can you watch the WNBA season? Games will be broadcast across a range of channels, including ABC, ESPN, NBC, and CBS, as well as streaming on Peacock, Paramount+, and Prime Video. You can also catch games on WNBA League Pass or through streaming services like DirecTV, Hulu + Live TV, and Fubo."
[Short music transition]
Host: "If you're looking for a streaming option, DirecTV offers a range of channels, including ABC, ESPN, and NBC, with prices starting at $84.99 per month. Hulu + Live TV is another option, with a free trial and prices starting at $89.99 per month. And if you're looking for a more affordable option, Fubo's 'Pro' plan starts at $48.99 per month and offers over 200 channels, including ESPN and CBS."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to our podcast. We hope you enjoy the WNBA season, and we'll catch you on the next episode!"
